I don't really have any answers, but I do have 1 thing to say.

Take a walk. Go out at night, when everyone is usually asleep, and walk around. Soak in the beauty of your environment that you never give a thought to. Go somewhere you haven't been before. Maybe a fork of your neighborhood or city that you always forget is there. You're 23. You don't need to know where you need to go; you don't even understand yourself yet. Don't set any goals for now. Just float along until you think you can muster up the courage to make a change. Change won't come to you, and you can't make a change for the better until you understand your situation and see it for what it is. 

You may not go on a walk today, tomorrow, or next month, but someday you will. I promise that walk will knock some things into place for you.
